scope.repository: Roomline working tree and Git index
scope.runtimeEnvironmentSource: task-specific app.env only; values retained in memory and never emitted
scope.candidatePaths: all tracked and non-ignored untracked files
scope.excluded: ignored build outputs, ignored runtime services/state and unrelated credentials/projects; expected non-secret origins/paths/configuration do not count as secret leaks
scope.limitations: Exact task-secret comparison plus bounded high-signal patterns, not a proof that all unknown secrets are absent. Images/PDFs are scanned as bytes; no OCR. Provider status is not queried.

method: Parse only runtime environment values of length >=16; classify secret/key/token/password values and credential-bearing connection URLs as sensitive; separately count expected non-secret origins/paths/configuration.
Compare sensitive task values in memory against every candidate file and stream every Git-index blob.
Inspect candidate paths for accidental environment, cookie/session, database and HTTP archive state; check changed files for private-key material and provider token shapes.

Validate local deployment project/environment/account/service consistency, variable maps, pinned infrastructure image digests, origin/processing/storage guards, source pinning status and required helper inclusion.
deploymentStatus: Infrastructure remains staged; source disconnected; selected commit pending; approval-gated deployment has not occurred. This read-only local review performs no provider actions.
